hints.title: ICE
hints.text: A wall of blue ice bars this tunnel. Ice never gives way: only a blast breaks it. You know the stick: its fuse burns down with every step and every second, five in all, and the blast clears the tiles right around it, never rock. Two tiles away you are safe.
hints.task: Take the silicon above you and the stick. Lay the stick beside the ice (key 1) and step back two tiles.

hints.title: GROUNDWATER
hints.text: You have picked up a pump: keep it for now. The shimmering earth in the floor at the end of this tunnel hides a spring. Water falls and spreads sideways, never climbs, and does you no harm: you only wade at half speed. A bat cannot fly through water. One sleeps in the passage below, the only way on, and it drowns if the passage floods.
hints.task: Take the spare stick, then dig down through the spring and the earth under it, climb straight back out and wait up here until the water has reached the bat.

hints.title: THE PUMP
hints.text: A boulder that stands in water will not be pushed. Press 5 in or beside a flood: the pump seals the spring and drains every flooded tile joined to it.
hints.task: Pump the water away, push the boulder east off the copper and dig down.

hints.title: LAVA VEINS
hints.text: The glowing seams in the earth below are lava veins. Break one open and lava pours out, and it stays: it falls and creeps sideways, never climbs, and one step into it is fatal. A tunnel dug beside or under a vein fills with lava behind you. The Geiger counter (key 3) shows for 15 seconds the bonus elements hidden in plain-looking earth.
hints.task: Take the Geiger counter and scan. Dig to the silver and the two glowing spots without breaking a vein, then head west along the bottom. Never walk back into a tunnel that lava has reached.

hints.title: A KEY IN THE ICE
hints.text: A locked door stands before the exit, and its key is frozen into the ice box ahead. A toxic barrel that falls and lands explodes like a stick of dynamite. One rests on a ledge beside the shaft up to the tellurium: dig past it and it rolls off into the shaft and drops onto the ice.
hints.task: Climb the shaft to the tellurium without stopping beside the barrel, wait at the top for the blast, then take the key.

hints.title: THE GROUND READ
hints.text: Ice, water, lava and a falling barrel: each follows its own rule, and you have now used every one of them. Walk into the door with the key and it opens. Next come the machines of the old mine. Take the tin and the exit!
